$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x - 3 y - 7 z &=7 \\ y + 2 z &=-3 \\ - 5 x + 15 y + 35 z &=-35\end{aligned}\right.
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & -7 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ -5 & 15 & 35 & -35\end{array}\right]
$$

First reduce the matrix to row echelon form, making each pivot equal to $1$.

$$
R_{3}:=R_{3}+\left(5\right)R_{1}\qquad M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & -7 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]
$$

In the row echelon form above, we have only two pivots (in the $1$st and $2$nd columns). To transform the matrix to reduced row echelon form, we need to create zeros above the pivots only.

$$
R_{1}:=R_{1}+\left(3\right)R_{2}\qquad M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]
$$
